turns.teacher: Good morning, children! Today we will do subtraction. Very nice, everyone is sitting so nicely.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Our first sum is fifty two minus twenty seven. Write it in your notebook. Rabi, what did you get?
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: No Ravi, thirty five is wrong. The answer is twenty five. Everybody say it, fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, you also wrote thirty five? I told you, it is twenty five. Twenty five! Listen carefully, you have to borrow, then it becomes twenty five.
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Very good, very good. Who got twenty five? Thumbs up.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Okay, next sum. Forty three minus eighteen. Do it quickly.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, twenty six? No, no, that is not correct. Don't count on fingers. Next, who else?
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: The answer is twenty five again. Forty three minus eighteen is twenty five. Write it down, all of you.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjun, again you made the same mistake! Borrow means borrow. I am saying again, when you borrow, you borrow. Okay?
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Very good, children, you all tried so hard. Close your notebooks now, we will do more tomorrow.
